<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Rigid Form](/Spells.aspx?ID=1408)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 197

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You utilize wood's rigidity to prevent harmful shapechanging effects. For the duration of this spell, whenever you're targeted by a harmful [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127) effect, you can use your reaction to attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the effect.

---
**Heightened (6th)** The duration increases to 10 minutes.
name: Rigid Form
